$$テッサ$$
「Heh... Sorry, but I saw through your sexual harassment scheme long ago.」

853:t_127:14.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If you insist on going through with it, $$ＳＲＴ$$... no, the entire crew of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will deal with you.」

853:t_127:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You have a keen tactical eye and the charisma to command these roughnecks... Oh, $$テッサ$$... you are so far beyond my reach...」

853:t_128:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You all aboard the $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ had quite a hard time, trapped in another dimension for so long.」

853:t_128:6.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Speaking of which, listen to this! $$アンネ$$ grew so much while I was gone!」

853:t_128:7.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$キヨウ$$ must have taught her well. She learned to say 'Daddy' even while I was away.」

853:t_128:8.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「And that's not all! She must take after me physically, because she's almost ready to run! She's just so, so adorable...」

853:t_128:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Please, talk to your heart's content, $$ダヤッカ$$... I would never be so tactless as to say this has nothing to do with celebrating your ace status.)

853:t_128:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I, $$ＡＧ$$, will keep you company as long as my willpower holds out. I can probably last about three more minutes...)

853:t_129:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「You don't need to fuss over me. This is your achievement too.」

853:t_129:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's how it is. Congratulations, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_129:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've always been treated so coldly in $c, but you're different, $$トライア$$!」

853:t_129:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Of course I am... I'm practically your accomplice, after all.」

853:t_129:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Y-you make me sound like a criminal...」

853:t_129:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「If you don't want people to think that, get to work. If we don't work much, much harder, the Earth and the universe are finished.」

853:t_129:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand! Today, I'll give it my all again... doing business, business!」
